source:
[u][b]The Fallen Aristocrat Oppai Mama![/b][/u]
Occupation: Other World Maid Cafe Waitress 
Workplace: The Maid Cafe in the Maid Academy, "Maidream"

She is the mother of [url=/c116133]Makina[/url] and one of the legendary maids who fought against the demon king's army in the past and won. She is elegant and neat, but quite glamorous, with Q-cup boobs.

Her personality is gentle and graceful, reminiscent of an aristocrat. However, she is also easily influenced, and the Blanchette family has fallen into decline after an acquaintance of the aristocrat swindled them out of their money. Makina, the daughter, felt responsible for this, but she stood by her mother without blaming her, and the money problem was resolved when the protagonist appeared on the scene. Because of this, she is very grateful to her daughter and the protagonist.

Currently, she works as a waitress at "Maidream" a maid café in the school, and is [url=/c116151]Maasa[/url]'s senior, who came from another world. It is hard to imagine from her current appearance, but when she was a student, she was even more high-handed than her daughter, Makina, and it is said that she made the demon king's army afraid of her as she slashed monsters around while smiling broadly.

She has a very good relationship with her daughter, and they often go out together on holidays. Makina respects and admires her mother, and Laurecia is grateful to her daughter for her continuous support. She is also quite fond of the protagonist, who has solved her family's problems and become her daughter's master, and she accepts the protagonist's sexual harassment, partly because she is naturally easily influenced....
